title: Weapon blocks select a weapon slot but receipt classification requires a shield
earliest_failed_contract: The accepted defensive implement is a weapon when a shieldless actor performs a neutral raised-guard Block. Slot selection handles this explicitly; receipt recording independently reconstructs Block as shield-only and discards the real contact.
counterexample: A party defender with a held WeaponItem and no ShieldItem raises guard while neutral. passive_block_response returns Block; defender_blocking_slot returns weapon side. On a successful physical Block with positive contact force, Core avoided_contact returns ToAttacker physical_contact=true. emit_melee_outcome carries the actual fallback weapon slot. record_melee_equipment_contacts sets require_shield=true solely because response is Block, so the correct owner/slot WeaponItem fails defender_equipment_contact_matches and receives no equipment stress receipt. These are supported source branches; no specific run occurrence asserted.
actual_recipient: TacticalConsequenceAccumulator.equipment_contacts is the mission equipment contact receipt, unlike diagnostic F097 counters. The loop finds no valid defender implement when require_shield is true and all defender items lack ShieldItem.
qualification: Shielded Block and Parry use the expected concrete implement paths. The witness concerns the explicit shieldless weapon Block fallback; no generic permission to block empty-handed or claim about current database durability processing beyond retained receipt omission. Accepted result may vary with actual skills/alignment, so occurrence is conditional on a successful physical contact.
connected_repair: Carry one authoritative accepted defensive implement identity/kind through contact resolution and receipt recording, or derive required classification from the same resolved actual item/slot. Do not infer shield identity merely from Block response.
acceptance: A successful positive-force shieldless weapon Block records defender weapon stress; a shield Block records its shield, and nonphysical miss/dodge records neither. No test/build/probe executed or added in this audit.
